This attack's damage isn't affected by any effects on your opponent's Active Pokémon.

ru: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Darkrai-EX

atk.x: This attack does 20 more damage for each Darkness Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.
If your opponent's Active Pokémon is Asleep, this attack does 80 more damage.

ru: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: Scizor-EX

atk.x: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to this Pokémon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
If this Pokémon was on the Bench and became your Active Pokémon this turn, this attack does 60 more damage.

ru: Pokémon-EX rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

name: M Scizor-EX

atk.x: You may discard a Special Energy attached to your opponent's Active Pokémon or a Stadium card in play.

ru: Mega Evolution rule: When 1 of your Pokémon becomes a Mega Evolution Pokémon, your turn ends.

name: Ho-Oh-EX

atk.x: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon. (Don't apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)

ab.x: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon has any basic Fire Energy attached to it, you may heal 50 damage from it.

name: Skyla
ru: Search your deck for a Trainer card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.
You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

name: Gyarados-EX
